content: There is a strong focus on minimizing the environmental externalities of blasting, such as ground vibration, noise, and the generation of dust and noxious fumes (particularly orange/brown nitrogen oxide or NOx). Contractors are increasingly evaluated on their ability to demonstrate control over these factors through precision timing and advanced blast design. There is also a growing interest in the carbon footprint of explosives themselves. Research and development efforts are underway to produce "greener" emulsions using alternative raw materials or by incorporating waste products. A contractor that can offer a verifiably lower-impact blasting solution has a compelling marketing advantage, particularly for mining houses that have made public ESG commitments.
